name: shape-flow
title: Shape Flow
description: Text that reflows around a floating ASCII duck, powered by Pretext.

useCases: Editorial text wrapping around a floating ASCII duck.
limitations: One left-to-right plain-text paragraph. Rich text and right-to-left flow are unsupported.
requirements: Use a loaded named font. Interactive layout needs Canvas 2D, Intl.Segmenter, and ResizeObserver.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/shape-flow.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
